Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild microcytosis. There is also monocytosis and basophilia. Other parameters, including renal and liver function, are within normal limits. Findings may suggest a possible underlying infection, inflammation, or bone marrow disorder; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
